description: This file declares helper functions and macros for processing msgpack-encoded data, including a function 'helper_convert' that decodes data, checks for a wrapper, and calls a process function. It is part of a larger system related to web configuration APIs.

methods.name: helper_convert
methods.description: Decodes msgpack data, checks for optional wrapper and expected type, then calls a process function, returning the processed object or NULL on error.
